edits.question: Summarize the passage above in three bullet points.
edits.context_old: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose. It occurs in the chloroplasts of plant cells. The process releases oxygen as a byproduct, which most life on Earth depends on.
edits.context_new: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose; it occurs in the chloroplasts of plant cells. The process releases oxygen as a byproduct, which most life on Earth depends on.

edits.label: Appended sentence (rewrite-heavy)
edits.question: Summarize the passage above in three bullet points.
edits.context_old: The Aral Sea was once the fourth-largest lake in the world. Soviet irrigation projects diverted its feeder rivers in the 1960s. By 2007 it had shrunk to a tenth of its original size, leaving behind a salt desert and a collapsed fishing industry.
edits.context_new: The Aral Sea was once the fourth-largest lake in the world. Soviet irrigation projects diverted its feeder rivers in the 1960s. By 2007 it had shrunk to a tenth of its original size, leaving behind a salt desert and a collapsed fishing industry. A 2005 dam has since partially restored the northern basin.

edits.label: Add an input guard clause
edits.question: Review this function for correctness bugs. Be concise.
edits.context_old:
def median(xs):
    s = sorted(xs)
    n = len(s)
    mid = n // 2
    if n % 2 == 1:
        return s[mid]
    return (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2
